-- abort and roll back unless count(trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence_rebuild_new) = 0 AND equals the live retained count
ALTER TABLE trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence RENAME TO candidate_point_in_time_evidence_retired_old
ALTER TABLE trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence_rebuild_new RENAME TO candidate_point_in_time_evidence

ALTER TABLE trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence ADD CONSTRAINT candidate_point_in_time_evidence_decision_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (decision_id) REFERENCES trade.decision(decision_id)

ALTER TABLE trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence ADD CONSTRAINT candidate_point_in_time_evidence_fusion_snapshot_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fusion_snapshot_id) REFERENCES trade.fusion_snapshot(fusion_snapshot_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW research.option_contract_risk_history AS SELECT candidate.candidate_id, candidate.decision_id, candidate.decision_time, candidate.branch, candidate.selected, candidate.hard_status, candidate.soft_status, candidate.contract_json ->> 'underlying'::text AS underlying, candidate.contract_json ->> 'contractSymbol'::text AS contract_symbol, candidate.contract_json ->> 'optionType'::text AS option_type, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(candidate.contract_json -> 'strike'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (candidate.contract_json ->> 'strike'::text)::numeric ELSE NULL::numeric END AS strike, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(candidate.contract_json -> 'dte'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (candidate.contract_json ->> 'dte'::text)::integer ELSE NULL::integer END AS dte, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(candidate.contract_json -> 'moneyness'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (candidate.contract_json ->> 'moneyness'::text)::numeric ELSE NULL::numeric END AS moneyness, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(candidate.volatility_json -> 'iv'::text) = 'number'::text THEN (candidate.volatility_json ->> 'iv'::text)::numeric ELSE NULL::numeric END AS implied_volatility, quote.bid, quote.ask, CASE WHEN quote.bid IS NOT NULL AND quote.ask IS NOT NULL AND quote.ask >= quote.bid THEN (quote.bid + quote.ask) / 2::numeric ELSE NULL::numeric END AS mid, CASE WHEN quote.bid IS NOT NULL AND quote.ask IS NOT NULL AND quote.ask >= quote.bid AND (quote.bid + quote.ask) > 0::numeric THEN (quote.ask - quote.bid) / ((quote.bid + quote.ask) / 2::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END AS relative_spread, quote.bid_size, quote.ask_size, quote.provider_timestamp, quote.ingestion_timestamp, quote.source, quote.operation_alias, quote.feed, quote.contract_version AS quote_contract_version, quote.data_quality, candidate.feature_version, candidate.strategy_version, candidate.provider_provenance_json, candidate.content_hash AS candidate_content_hash, quote.content_hash AS quote_content_hash FROM trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence candidate LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT observation.quote_observation_id, observation.candidate_id, observation.management_input_snapshot_id, observation.observation_role, observation.observed_at, observation.provider_timestamp, observation.ingestion_timestamp, observation.source, observation.operation_alias, observation.feed, observation.contract_version, observation.bid, observation.ask, observation.bid_size, observation.ask_size, observation.proposed_limit, observation.data_quality, observation.content_hash, observation.created_at FROM market.execution_quote_observation observation WHERE observation.candidate_id = candidate.candidate_id AND observation.observation_role = 'DECISION'::text ORDER BY observation.observed_at DESC, observation.quote_observation_id DESC LIMIT 1) quote ON true;
CREATE TRIGGER reject_immutable_mutation BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core.reject_immutable_mutation()
COMMIT
-- LATER, separately approved: DROP TABLE trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence_retired_old   (returns 1474084864 bytes before the retained rows are subtracted)

ALTER TABLE trade.candidate_point_in_time_evidence ADD CONSTRAINT candidate_point_in_time_evidence_fusion_snapshot_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fusion_snapshot_id) REFERENCES trade.fusion_snapshot(fusion_snapshot_id)
